data.long_meaning: Dolan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhan' which means wealth or gift. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that the name was given to a child born as a divine gift. The name is also associated with Lord Shiva and is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Dolan carries the meaning “Gift from God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dolan usually hope their child will grow to embody gift from god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
